name: context-halo
description: Context window usage you can read at a glance: a halo above the prompt, a Rings pane, prompt-cache countdown, and a heads-up before auto-compact.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a reply: 5m on most plans, 1h when your account uses the long cache.

warnAt.title: Heads-up at (%)
warnAt.description: Show a toast once when context passes this percentage.

criticalAt.title: Critical at (%)
criticalAt.description: Turn the halo red, show a Compact button and toast once at this percentage.
